name: Keep It Rolling
description: Increase the remaining duration of your active Roll the Bones combat enhancement by 30 sec.

name: Preparation
description: Immediately reset the cooldowns of Adrenaline Rush, Between the Eyes, Blade Flurry, Blade Rush, and Killing Spree.

name: Adrenaline Rush
description: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 75%, your maximum Energy by 50, and your attack speed by 20% for 15 sec.

name: Killing Spree
description:
Finishing move that unleashes a barrage of gunfire, striking random enemies within 8 yards for Physical damage. Number of strikes increased per combo point.

Restores 1 combo point every 0.45 sec. Each combo point spent above 5 increases damage by 15%.

   1 point  : 315 over 0.45 sec
   2 points: 472 over 0.89 sec
   3 points: 629 over 1.34 sec
   4 points: 786 over 1.78 sec
   5 points: 944 over 2.23 sec

name: Blind
description: Blinds the target, causing it to wander disoriented for 1 min. Damage may interrupt the effect. Limit 1.

name: Cloak of Shadows
description: Provides a moment of magic immunity, instantly removing all harmful spell effects. The cloak lingers, causing you to resist harmful spells for 5 sec.

name: Evasion
description: Increases your dodge chance by 100% for 10 sec.

name: Blade Rush
description:
Charge to your target with your blades out, dealing 297 Physical damage to the target and 133 to all other nearby enemies. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.

While Blade Flurry is active, damage to non-primary targets is increased by 100%.

Generates 25 Energy over 5 sec.

name: Shiv
description: Attack with your off-hand, dealing 2 Physical damage, dispelling all enrage effects and applying a concentrated form of your active Non-Lethal poison.\n\nAwards 1 combo point.

name: Tricks of the Trade
description: Redirects all threat you cause to the targeted party or raid member, beginning with your next damaging attack within the next 30 sec and lasting 6 sec.

name: Gouge
description:
Gouges the eyes of an enemy target, incapacitating for 4 sec. Damage may interrupt the effect.

Must be in front of your target.

Awards 1 combo point.

name: Thistle Tea
description: Restore 100 Energy.\n\nWhen your Energy is reduced below 30, drink a Thistle Tea.

name: Atrophic Poison
description: Coats your weapons with a Non-Lethal Poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 30% chance of poisoning the enemy, reducing their damage by 4.0% for 1 min.

name: Numbing Poison
description: Coats your weapons with a Non-Lethal Poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 30% chance of poisoning the enemy, clouding their mind and slowing their attack and casting speed by 15% for 10 sec.

name: Shroud of Concealment
description: Extend a cloak that shrouds party and raid members within 30 yards in shadows, providing stealth for 15 sec.

name: Sprint
description: Increases your movement speed by 70% for 8 sec. Usable while stealthed.

name: Between the Eyes
description:
Finishing move that blasts your target with your pistol, dealing Physical damage and increasing your damage dealt by 4%. Multiple instances of this bonus can overlap.
   1 point : 18 damage, 4 sec
   2 points: 37 damage, 6 sec
   3 points: 55 damage, 8 sec
   4 points: 74 damage, 10 sec
   5 points: 92 damage, 12 sec

name: Roll the Bones
description:
Roll the dice of fate, providing a combat enhancement of random power for 30 sec.

1 set or better: Add 20% increased chance to gain Opportunity.

2 sets or better: Add increased combo point generation.

3 sets or better: Add 30% bonus to Restless Blades' effect.

Jackpot: Add 10% increased critical strike chance.

name: Crimson Vial
description: Drink an alchemical concoction that heals you for 20% of your maximum health over 4 sec.

name: Distract
description: Throws a distraction, attracting the attention of all nearby monsters for 10 seconds. Usable while stealthed.

name: Kidney Shot
description:
Finishing move that stuns the target. Lasts longer per combo point, up to 8 sec:
   1 point : 4 seconds
   2 points: 5 seconds
   3 points: 6 seconds
   4 points: 7 seconds
   5 points: 8 seconds

name: Kick
description: A quick kick that interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 6 sec.

name: Stealth
description: Conceals you in the shadows until cancelled, allowing you to stalk enemies without being seen.

name: Find Treasure
description: You can sense nearby treasure, making it appear on the minimap. Lasts until canceled.

name: Cheap Shot
description: Stuns the target for 6 sec.\n\nAwards 1 combo point.

name: Feint
description: Performs an evasive maneuver, reducing damage taken from area-of-effect attacks by 40% for 6 sec.

name: Vanish
description: Allows you to vanish from sight, entering stealth while in combat. For the first 3 sec after vanishing, damage and harmful effects received will not break stealth. Also breaks movement impairing effects.

name: Grappling Hook
description: Launch a grappling hook and pull yourself to the target location.

name: Pick Pocket
description: Pick the target's pocket.

name: Ambush
description: Ambush the target, causing 99 Physical damage.\n\nAwards 2 combo points.

name: Blade Flurry
description: $@spelldesc319606

name: Create: Crimson Vial
description:
Create a Crimson Vial to share with allies. Maximum of 3 can be carried at once. 

 Crimson Vial
Drink an alchemical concoction that heals you for 30% of your maximum health over 6 sec.

name: Crippling Poison
description: Coats your weapons with a Non-Lethal Poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 30% chance to poison the enemy, slowing movement speed by 50% for 12 sec.

name: Deadly Poison
description: Coats your weapons with a Lethal Poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 30% chance to poison the enemy for 27 Nature damage over 12 sec. Subsequent poison applications will instantly deal 2 Nature damage.

name: Detection
description: Focus intently on trying to detect certain creatures.

name: Dispatch
description:
Finishing move that dispatches the enemy, dealing damage per combo point:
   1 point  : 21 damage
   2 points: 43 damage
   3 points: 63 damage
   4 points: 84 damage
   5 points: 109 damage

name: Eviscerate
description:
Finishing move that disembowels the target, causing damage per combo point.
   1 point  : 13 damage
   2 points: 26 damage
   3 points: 38 damage
   4 points: 51 damage
   5 points: 66 damage

name: Instant Poison
description: Coats your weapons with a Lethal Poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 30% chance of poisoning the enemy which instantly inflicts 2 Nature damage.

name: Main Gauche
description: Your main-hand attacks have a 30% chance to trigger an attack with your off-hand that deals 0 Physical damage.

name: Mutilate
description: Instantly attacks for 40 Physical damage.\n\nAwards 1 combo point.

name: Pick Lock
description: Allows opening of locked chests and doors that require a skill level of up to 70.

name: Pistol Shot
description: Draw a concealed pistol and fire a quick shot at an enemy, dealing 29 Physical damage and reducing the target's movement speed by 30% for 6 sec.\n\nAwards 1 combo point.

name: Sap
description: Incapacitates a target not in combat for 1 min. Only works on Humanoids, Beasts, Demons, and Dragonkin. Damage will revive the target. Limit 1.

name: Single-Button Assistant
description: Casts damaging abilities for use in combat, rotating through them based on priority.\n\nThe global cooldown of abilities used through the Single-Button Assistant is 25% longer.

name: Sinister Strike
description: Viciously strike an enemy, causing 31 Physical damage.\n\nAwards 1 combo point.

name: Slice and Dice
description:
Finishing move that consumes combo points to increase attack speed by 50%. Lasts longer per combo point.
   1 point  : 12 seconds
   2 points: 18 seconds
   3 points: 24 seconds
   4 points: 30 seconds
   5 points: 36 seconds

name: Wound Poison
description: Coats your weapons with a Lethal Poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 30% chance to poison the enemy, which instantly inflicts 1 Nature damage and reduces all healing received by 8% for 12 sec, stacking up to 3 times.

name: Smoke Bomb
description: Creates a cloud of thick smoke in an 8 yard radius around the Rogue for 5 sec. Enemies are unable to target into or out of the smoke cloud.

name: Dismantle
description: Disarm the enemy, preventing the use of any weapons or shield for 5 sec.

name: Death from Above
description: Finishing move that empowers your weapons with energy to perform a deadly attack.\n\nYou leap into the air and Eviscerate your target on the way back down, with such force that it has a 15% stronger effect.

name: Boarding Party
description: Between the Eyes increases the movement speed of all friendly players within 15 yards by 30% for 6 sec.

name: Control is King
description: Cheap Shot grants Slice and Dice for 15 sec and Kidney Shot restores 10 Energy per combo point spent.

name: Dagger in the Dark
description: Each second while Stealth is active, nearby enemies within 12 yards take an additional 2% damage from you for 10 sec. Stacks up to 6 times.

name: Drink Up Me Hearties
description: Crimson Vial restores 5% additional maximum health and grants 60% of its healing to allies within 15 yds.

name: Maneuverability
description: Sprint has 50% reduced cooldown and 50% reduced duration.

name: Preemptive Maneuver
description: Feint decreases your damage taken by an additional 40% while stunned and its energy cost is reduced by 30%.

name: Thick as Thieves
description: Tricks of the Trade now increases the friendly target's damage by 15% for 6 sec.

name: Turn the Tables
description: After coming out of a stun, you deal 10% increased damage for 12 sec.

name: Ace Up Your Sleeve
description: Between the Eyes has a 3% chance per combo point spent to grant 4 combo points and reset its own cooldown.

name: Acrobatic Strikes
description: Auto-attacks increase auto-attack damage by 3% and movement speed by 1% for 3 sec, stacking up to 10 times.

name: Airborne Irritant
description: Blind has 50% reduced cooldown, 70% reduced duration, and applies to all nearby enemies.

name: Alacrity
description: Haste increased by 1.5%.

name: Audacity
description:
Using Pistol Shot with Opportunity has a 30% chance to make your next Ambush usable without Stealth.

Chance to trigger this effect matches the chance for Sinister Strike to grant Opportunity.

Ambush damage increased by 80%.

name: Blackjack
description: Enemies have 30% reduced damage and healing for 6 sec after Blind or Sap's effect on them ends.

name: Blinding Powder
description: Reduces the cooldown of Blind by 25% and increases its range by 5 yds.

name: Cheat Death
description: Fatal attacks instead reduce you to 7% of your maximum health. For 3 sec afterward, you take 85% reduced damage. Cannot trigger more often than once per 6 min.

name: Chosen's Revelry
description: Flipping a Fatebound Coin restores 10 health.

name: Clever Combatant
description: Shuriken Storm has 10% increased critical strike chance and now triggers Unseen Blade when available.

name: Cloud Cover
description: Activating Shadow Blades creates a cloud of smoke for 6 sec, allowing attacks from within the cloud to apply Fazed, stacking up to 2 additional times.\n\nEffect persists for 6 sec after leaving the cloud.

name: Cold Blooded Killer
description: Critically striking with an attack that generates combo points increases the critical strike chance of your next finishing move by 10%.

name: Combat Potency
description: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 16%.

name: Combat Stamina
description: Stamina increased by 5%.

name: Controlled Chaos
description: After flipping a Fatebound Coin that ends a streak of 4 or more, flip another that matches the same face.

name: Coup de Grace
description: After 4 strikes with Unseen Blade, your next Eviscerate will be performed as a Coup de Grace, functioning as if it had consumed 5 additional combo points, and granting you 5 stacks of Flawless Form.

name: Crescendo of Violence
description: Your finishing moves deal 10% increased damage.

name: Dancing Steel
description: Blade Flurry strikes 3 additional enemies and its duration is increased by 3 sec.

name: Danger Sense
description: You have a 20% chance to partially evade any damage dealt to you, reducing the damage it deals by 20%.

name: Deadened Nerves
description: Physical damage taken reduced by 5%.

name: Deadly Precision
description: Increases the critical strike chance of your attacks that generate combo points by 5%.

name: Deadly Pursuit
description: After spending 15 combo points, if you spend no combo points for 4 sec, abilities affected by Restless Blades will cool down 200% faster for 5 sec or until you spend a combo point.

name: Deal Fate
description: Mutilate, Ambush, and Fan of Knives have a 60% chance to generate 1 additional combo point when they trigger Seal Fate.

name: Death's Arrival
description: Grappling Hook may be used a second time within 3 sec with no cooldown, but its total cooldown is increased by 5 sec.

name: Deep Cuts
description: Your finishing moves deal 6% increased damage.

name: Deeper Stratagem
description: Gain 1 additional max combo point.\n\nYour finishing moves that consume more than 5 combo points have increased effects, and your finishing moves deal 5% increased damage.

name: Deft Maneuvers
description: Blade Flurry's initial damage is increased by 100% and generates 1 combo point per target struck, but its Energy cost is increased by 30.

name: Delivered Doom
description: Envenom deals 5% more damage when it consumes 5 or more combo points.

name: Destiny Defined
description: Sinister Strike has 5% increased chance to strike an additional time and grant Opportunity and your Fatebound Coins flipped have an additional 5% chance to match the same face as the last flip.

name: Devious Distractions
description: Secret Technique applies Fazed to any targets struck.

name: Devious Stratagem
description: Gain 1 additional max combo point.\n\nYour finishing moves that consume more than 5 combo points have increased effects, and your finishing moves deal 5% increased damage.

name: Disorienting Strikes
description: Secret Technique has 10% reduced cooldown and allows your next 2 strikes of Unseen Blade to ignore its cooldown.

name: Don't Be Suspicious
description: Blind and Shroud of Concealment have 10% reduced cooldown.\n\nPick Pocket and Sap have 10 yd increased range.

name: Dragon-Bone Dice
description:
The bonuses granted by your Roll the Bones are stronger.

Bonuses to chance for Sinister Strike to strike twice are 5% greater.
Bonuses to Sinister Strike and Ambush damage are 5% greater.
Bonuses to Restless Blades cooldown reduction are 10% greater.
Jackpot's bonus to critical strike chance is 5% greater.

name: Echoing Reprimand
description: After consuming a supercharged combo point, your next Mutilate also strikes the target with an Echoing Reprimand dealing 41 Physical damage.

name: Edge Case
description: Activating Deathmark flips a Fatebound Coin and causes it to land on its edge, counting as both Heads and Tails.

name: Elusiveness
description: Evasion also reduces damage taken by 20%, and Feint also reduces non-area-of-effect damage taken by 20%.

name: Expert Duelist
description: Between the Eyes increases your damage dealt by an additional 2%.

name: Fan the Hammer
description: When you gain Opportunity, gain 1 additional charge. Max 6 charges.\n\nPistol Shot consumes 1 additional charge of Opportunity to fire 1 additional bullet. Additional shots deal 20% reduced damage.

name: Fast Action
description: The cooldown of Between the Eyes is reduced by 8 sec.\n\nBetween the Eyes increases your damage dealt by an additional 1%.

name: Fatal Flourish
description: Your off-hand attacks and Pistol Shots have a 25% chance to generate 8 Energy.

name: Fate Intertwined
description: Caustic Spatter causes an additional 5% of Nature damage dealt to be dealt to affected enemies.

name: Featherfoot
description: Sprint increases movement speed by an additional 30% and has 4 sec increased duration.

name: Find an Opening
description: Your chance for Sinister Strike to strike twice and grant Opportunity is increased by 10%

name: Flashing Steel
description: Unseen Blade may now occur once every 15 sec and has 25% chance to strike twice.

name: Flawless Form
description: Unseen Blade and Secret Technique increase the damage of your finishing moves by 4% for 12 sec. Max 5 stacks.

name: Fleet Footed
description: Movement speed increased by 15%.

name: Flickering Steel
description: Sinister Strike and Ambush deal 20% increased damage. They also generate 5 Energy when they grant you Opportunity.

name: Flickerstrike
description: Taking damage from an area-of-effect attack while Feint is active or dodging while Evasion is active refreshes your opportunity to strike with Unseen Blade.\n\nThis effect may only occur once every 5 sec.

name: Forced Induction
description: Increase the bonus granted when a damaging finishing move consumes a supercharged combo point by 1.

name: Graceful Guile
description: Feint has 1 additional charge.

name: Grand Melee
description: Blade Flurry causes your attacks to hit nearby enemies for an additional 8% of their normal damage.

name: Gravedigger
description: Between the Eyes has a 45% chance to apply 2 stacks of its bonus to your damage dealt.

name: Hand of Fate
description: Flip a Fatebound Coin each time a finishing move consumes 5 or more combo points. Heads increases the damage of your attacks by 10%, lasting 15 sec or until you flip Tails. Tails deals 58 Cosmic damage to your target.\n\nFor each time the same face is flipped in a row, Heads increases damage by an additional 2% and Tails increases its damage by 10%.

name: Heavy Hitter
description: Attacks that generate combo points deal 15% increased damage.

name: Heightened Rush
description: Adrenaline Rush's duration is increased by 4 sec.

name: Hidden Opportunity
description: Ambush has a chance to grant Opportunity. Chance to trigger this effect is 100% of the chance for Sinister Strike to grant Opportunity.\n\nEnergy cost of Ambush reduced by 5.

name: Hit and Run
description: Movement speed increased by 15%.

name: Hoodwink
description: Fazed increases damage taken by an additional 3%.

name: Improved Adrenaline Rush
description: Generate full combo points when you gain Adrenaline Rush.

name: Improved Ambush
description: Ambush generates 1 additional combo point.

name: Improved Between the Eyes
description: Critical strikes with Between the Eyes deal 2.5 times normal damage.

name: Improved Sprint
description: Reduces the cooldown of Sprint by 60 sec.

name: Improved Wound Poison
description: Wound Poison can now stack 2 additional times.

name: Inexorable March
description: You cannot be slowed below 70% of normal movement speed while your Fatebound Coin flips have an active streak of at least 2 flips matching the same face.

name: Iron Stomach
description: Increases the healing you receive from Crimson Vial, healing potions, and healthstones by 25%.

name: Leeching Poison
description: Adds a Leeching effect to your Lethal poisons, granting you 3.0% Leech.

name: Lethality
description: Critical strike chance increased by 1%. Critical strike damage bonus of your attacks that generate combo points increased by 10%.

name: Loaded Dice
description: Activating Adrenaline Rush improves the result of your next Roll the Bones by one level.

name: Lucky Coin
description: Every 7 coin flips, keep a lucky coin that bends you towards your fate for 12 sec. Your Agility is increased by 4%, the damage and bonuses of Fatebound Coins are increased by 50%, and coin flips are 15% more likely to match the same face as the last flip.\n\nCoin flips do not count toward finding a lucky coin while you have a lucky coin.

name: Master Poisoner
description: Increases the non-damaging effects of your weapon poisons by 20%.

name: Mean Streak
description: Fatebound Coins flipped by Envenom are 33% more likely to match the same face as the last flip.

name: Menacing Rush
description: Adrenaline Rush magnifies your precision and power, increasing the damage your combo point generating abilities and finishers deal by 20%.

name: Mirrors
description: Feint reduces damage taken from area-of-effect attacks by an additional 10%

name: Nimble Fingers
description: Energy cost of Feint and Crimson Vial reduced by 10.

name: Nimble Flurry
description: Your auto-attacks, Unseen Blade, and Coup de Grace also strike up to 7 nearby enemies for 50% of normal damage while Flawless Form is active.

name: No Scruples
description: Finishing moves have 12% increased chance to critically strike Fazed targets.

name: Opportunity
description:
Sinister Strike has a 30% chance to hit an additional time and grant Opportunity.

 Opportunity
Your next Pistol Shot costs 50% less Energy and deals 100% increased damage.

name: Overflowing Purse
description: Envenom has a 15% chance to flip 3 Fatebound Coins.

name: Precision Shot
description: Between the Eyes and Pistol Shot have 10 yd increased range and deal 20% increased damage.

name: Quick Draw
description: Opportunity increases the damage of Pistol Shot by an additional 20%. Each charge of Opportunity consumed by Pistol Shot generates 1 combo point.

name: Quick Fingers
description: Increases your Agility by 3%.

name: Ravenholdt Mint
description: Flipping Heads increases damage by an additional 4%. Damage dealt by flipping Tails is increased by 12%.

name: Recuperator
description: Slice and Dice heals you for up to 1% of your maximum health per 3 sec.

name: Retractable Hook
description: Reduces the cooldown of Grappling Hook by 15 sec.

name: Rush to the Inevitable
description: Gain 5 Energy every time you flip a Fatebound Coin. Gain 15 Energy for Coins that land on their edge.

name: Ruthlessness
description: Your finishing moves have a 20% chance per combo point spent to grant a combo point.

name: Sanguine Vial
description: When you deal the killing blow to a target that yields experience or honor, the cooldown of Crimson Vial is reduced by 15 sec and your next use heals 5% of your health instantly.

name: Shadowrunner
description: While Stealth or Shadow Dance is active, you move 20% faster.

name: Sleight of Hand
description: Roll the Bones has a 20% increased chance of granting more powerful results.

name: Smoke
description: You take 5% reduced damage from Fazed targets.

name: So Tricky
description: Tricks of the Trade's threat redirect duration is increased to 1 hour.

name: Sometimes Lucky
description: Critical strike chance increased by 3%.

name: Soothing Darkness
description: You are healed for 30% of your maximum health over 6 sec after activating Vanish.

name: Stillshroud
description: Shroud of Concealment has 50% reduced cooldown.

name: Subterfuge
description: Abilities requiring Stealth can be used for 3 sec after Stealth breaks.\n\nCombat benefits requiring Stealth persist for an additional 3 sec after Stealth breaks.

name: Summarily Dispatched
description: Dispatch deals 15% increased damage and costs 3 less Energy. This damage bonus is increased by 50% while your damage is enhanced by your Between the Eyes.

name: Supercharger
description: Kingsbane supercharges 1 combo point.\n\nDamaging finishing moves consume a supercharged combo point to function as if they spent 2 additional combo points.

name: Superior Mixture
description: Crippling Poison reduces movement speed by an additional 10%.

name: Surprising Strikes
description: Attacks that generate combo points deal 50% increased critical strike damage to Fazed targets.

name: Swift Slasher
description: Slice and Dice grants additional attack speed equal to 100% of your Haste.

name: Tempted Fate
description: You have a 30% chance to absorb 10% of any damage taken.

name: Thief's Versatility
description: Versatility increased by 3%.

name: Thousand Cuts
description: Slice and Dice grants 10% additional attack speed and gives your auto-attacks a chance to refresh your opportunity to strike with Unseen Blade.

name: Thrill Seeking
description: Shadowstep has 1 additional charge.

name: Tight Spender
description: Energy cost of finishing moves reduced by 6%.

name: Toxic Stiletto
description: Shiv's Energy cost is reduced by 20, its cooldown is reduced by 15 sec, and its range is increased by 3 yds.

name: Unbreakable Stride
description: Reduces the duration of movement slowing effects 30%.

name: Unseen Blade
description:
Backstab and Shadowstrike now also strike with an Unseen Blade dealing 99 damage. Targets struck are Fazed for 10 sec.

Fazed enemies take 5% more damage from you and cannot parry your attacks.

This effect may occur once every 20 sec.

name: Vigor
description: Increases your maximum Energy by 50 and Energy regeneration by 5%.

name: Virulent Poisons
description: Increases the damage of your weapon poisons by 10%.

name: Without a Trace
description: Vanish has 1 additional charge.

name: Zero In
description: Your auto-attack critical strikes increase the damage and critical strike chance of your next Between the Eyes by 2%, stacking up to 20 times.

name: Fang Strike
description: Sinister Strike and Ambush have a $s1% chance to cause your next Dispatch to be free and deal damage as if you spent the maximum combo points.
